item.title: Build Agent With Docker
item.description: 使用Dockerfile构建Zabbix Agent程序 创建Dockerfile文件 # 阶段 1: 构建环境 (Builder) FROM alpine:latest AS builder # 1. 设置镜像源并安装编译依赖 RUN sed -i 's/dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/g' /etc/apk/repositories && \ apk add --no-cache \ make automake autoconf gcc g++ libc-dev pkgconfig \ tar linux-headers \ pcre2-dev pcre2-static # 2. 复制源码包 COPY ./openssl-3.5.6.tar.gz /tmp/ COPY ./zabbix-7.0.25.tar.gz /tmp/ WORKDIR /tmp # 3. 编译 OpenSSL (静态库) RUN tar -zxvf openssl-3.5.6.tar.gz && \ cd openssl-3.5.6 && \ ./config --prefix=/opt/openssl no-shared no-zlib -static && \ make -j$(nproc) && \ make install_sw && \ cd /tmp && rm -rf openssl-3.
